[-Thinking-]
Let's think what other aspects of the domain might be in the interviewee's knowledge base:
- Weather conditions (wind, cold, rain, etc.)
- Corridors (altitude, one-way/two-way, capacity, shared corridors across companies?)
Let's ask about corridors and whether multiple companies or multiple drones fly in the same corridors at the same time.
[/-Thinking-]Can drones from different companies or multiple drones from your own company use the same corridors or sites at the same time?
